newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Jan tax receipts at 8.405 bln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Jan tax receipts at 8.405 bln reais.

text.p: Brazil's federal tax receipts in January totaled 8.405 billion reais, up from 7.080 billion reais in January 1996, the Finance Ministry said in a statment.

In December, Brazil's tax receipts were 10.304 billion reais, the statement said. January's result was lower than December's mainly due to payments of bonus salaries to public workers in December and traditionally lower economic activity in January, it said.
